CFML Language Reference: Functions

WriteOutput

Appends a string to the page output. It is the CFSCRIPT counterpart of CFOUTPUT: script code has no other way to produce output.

Category

Other functions

Syntax

WriteOutput(string)

Parameters

string
The text to write. It is not evaluated again, so pound signs are written as they are.

Returns

YES. The useful work is the output.

Usage

Output written with WriteOutput is subject to the same rules as other page output; in particular, CFSETTING ENABLECFOUTPUTONLY="Yes" does not suppress it. Remember to call HTMLEditFormat on data that might contain angle brackets.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSCRIPT>
  speeds = "14.4,28.8,33.6,56";
  WriteOutput("<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>");
  WriteOutput("<TR><TH>Modem (Kbps)</TH><TH>1 MB download</TH></TR>");
  for (i = 1; i LTE ListLen(speeds); i = i + 1) {
    kbps = ListGetAt(speeds, i);
    seconds = Round(8 * 1024 / kbps);
    WriteOutput("<TR><TD>" & kbps & "</TD><TD>" & Int(seconds / 60) & " min " & (seconds MOD 60) & " s</TD></TR>");
  }
  WriteOutput("</TABLE>");
</CFSCRIPT>
